title: Take 274 KB of traced glyph paths off the workspace graph: load art by id
deviations_from_card: (1) Write set grew by app/_lib/api-response.ts (one REFUSAL_ERRORS entry, GLYPH_UNKNOWN) + the 4 catalogs under the lock, because the card's own case 8 demands a coded 404 and no generic NOT_FOUND refusal exists. (2) Added a colocated glyphCatalog.test.ts (catalog parity case) instead of folding it into glyphRegistry.test.ts. (3) The route does NOT call requireOperator: requireOperator 401s demo-workspace sessions, which are shown the workspace empty states; the handler re-checks open mode OR any verified session (the proxy's own semantics) and the feat commit carries a targeted `Gate-exemption: route-auth-posture at app/api/glyphs/[id]/route.ts` trailer for review:constitution. (4) Tests and implementation landed in ONE refactor commit (tests-first commit would not compile/typecheck alone); the shared-surface edits are their own commits. (5) Feature docs got a Doc-sync internal-only trailer (prop swaps only); docs/design/README.md section rewritten.
notes: Page graph (npm run perf:budget -- --explain app/page.tsx, shared checkout incl. siblings' uncommitted work): 1388 modules / 8863 KB before -> 1380 / 8631 KB after (-232 KB net of sibling drift in the same window). perf-budget.json app/page.tsx lowered 1388/8875 -> 1382/8645 with a why (c735d79fb). New route walks 38 modules / 760 KB (group ceiling 227/3021). The 13 generated glyph modules are byte-identical (git diff f49369418..HEAD on them is empty). All 8 cases were observed red before (modules/exports missing -> file-level failures; the route test file could not import its route). Full test:unit: 3 failing files, all sibling in-flight: loading-gap-debt (DevTabCasesView.tsx uncommitted), candidateMatrixContracts (CandidateMatrix.tsx uncommitted), error-response-contract FLAKE (passed on re-run). test:perf red lines besides job-ingest 402/400 are route overrides +1..4 KB; measured per route that is ~7.9 KB of siblings' UNCOMMITTED files (db/devcase.ts etc.) - at committed HEAD each is under its ceiling (e.g. jds/generate 3015/3021, redraft 3030/3034). api:check on the working tree flags only sibling uncommitted routes /api/devcase/[id] and /api/pipeline/stage-sla; the committed api-reference.md row count (247/326) matches the committed tree, so whoever commits those routes must run api:docs. tsc on the working tree: red only on sibling paths (devcase/[id] route code DEVCASE_CASE_NOT_FOUND, PipelineSlaEditor, CandidateDetailModal, require-operator.test.ts, kpi-sim/). Not verified in a browser (no dev server per brief): placeholder is the same sized <svg> with no paths; entrance plays on arrival.
